text:
Sam R: Quick thread to align on onboarding constraints for open-model partners when we want to list in cloud marketplaces and bundle with HW/SI. TL;DR: need deterministic SKUs, manifest checksum, license flags, export gating, and announcement cadence.
Nina (Marketplace): Agree. Marketplace needs a single canonical SKU per (model, build, region, bundle). Suggest `vendor.model.build.region.bundle` e.g. `acme-spark-13b-q8-gcp-eu-hwpack`.
Omar (HW Partnerships): For HW bundles we also need `hw_rev` and `quant_profile` as part of SKU. Example: `acme-spark-13b-q8-gcp-eu-hwpack-v2`.
Clara (Legal): From legal: we must collect SPDX license id, redistrib permission checkbox, and any addendum for commercial rehosting. Also capture whether supplier requires attribution or prevents sublicensing.
Devon (Ops): Operational note: we should require a signed manifest.json with fields: `spdx_id`, `sha256`, `origin_url`, `allowed_sublicense` (y/n), `export_classification`. We can validate signature with partner cert.
Helga (SI): For SI integrations, we often need 'partner_fork' builds where SI adds optimizations. We need to make sure search and billing treat forked builds as separate SKUs and revenue share is configurable.
Sam R: Good. Also need a short public-facing provenance badge for listings: one of ["Upstream", "Partner build", "Vendor fork"], plus a small tooltip linking to manifest.
Nina (Marketplace): On announcement cadence: cloud marketplaces often need 7-14 day listing approvals. For joint press releases we usually target a 2-week embargo to coordinate PR and marketplace listing times.
Omar (HW Partnerships): Hardware partners want an embargo window too since some bundle photos and integrations require lead time. Recommend standard 10 business days for co-marketing notice.
Clara (Legal): Action: I can draft a short redistribution clause to include in onboarding that covers rehosting, attribution, export checks, and embargo notice. Important: suppliers may want custom export controls; manifest `export_classification` must be respected.
Devon (Ops): Automated enforcement: if `export_classification` flags embargo or restricted, we auto-block regions in listing and mark `blocked_regions` in dashboard. DeployBot: Policy rule added: block regions when manifest export flag != "unrestricted".
Helga (SI): Revenue share: SI-optimized builds sometimes have a different price. We should allow marketplace sellers to set `price_override` per SKU and record `revenue_split` in contract.
Sam R: Can we agree on minimal onboarding checklist now so partners can self-serve? Proposed minimal fields: `vendor_name`, `model_name`, `spdx_id`, `sha256`, `build_tag`, `quant_profile`, `allowed_sublicense`, `export_classification`, `provenance_type`, `contact_email`, `co-marketing_window_days`.
Nina (Marketplace): +1. Also require a short description (100 chars) for marketplace card and at least one screenshot or sample inference snippet for verification.
Clara (Legal): I'll add `spdx_id` enforcement and a checkbox `consent_rehost` to onboarding UI. If `consent_rehost` is false, we mark listing as "link-only" (points to upstream hosting) and disallow rehosting.
Omar (HW Partnerships): For HW bundles we need to collect `max_batch_size_recommendation` and `perf_profile` CSV so marketing can publish expected throughput numbers.
Devon (Ops): Ops will implement manifest signature check and SKU parser. Timeline: prototype by Wed, validation web-hook by next Monday.
Sam R: Okay owners: Clara -> legal clause draft by Tue COB; Nina -> marketplace UI changes (badge + fields) by Wed EOD; Omar -> HW bundle metadata examples by Wed; Devon -> prototype manifest validator by Wed. Helga -> SI revenue-split template and example by Thu.
Helga (SI): Noted. Also can we include a short clause about permitted optimizations (e.g., quantization allowed, architecture changes not allowed)? Some vendors object to heavy model surgery.
Clara (Legal): Addendum idea: three-tier opt-in for modifications: (1) "No modifications" (vendor-only), (2) "Allowed optimizations" (quantization, pruning with attribution), (3) "Open fork" (full fork permitted). Record `modification_level` in manifest.
Nina (Marketplace): UX: filter by `modification_level` and show label. Search ranking should prefer canonical unless user explicitly expands.
Sam R: Final quick question: embargo vs auto-listing. If partner sets `co-marketing_window_days` > 0, we hold listing until launch date; otherwise auto-list when manifest validated. Agree?
Omar (HW Partnerships): Agree. HW partners may require manual check before listing for photos/specs.
Clara (Legal): One more legal note: require partner to provide indemnity checkbox if `allowed_sublicense` = true.
Devon (Ops): I'll add webhook to notify ops and partnerships Slack channel when a manifest fails validation: `#partnerships` with reason. DeployBot: Webhook rule created: manifest.validation.failed -> notify #partnerships with payload {sha256, reason}.
Sam R: Great work. I'll open partnership-ticket-9423 with the checklist and owners. Please drop any sample manifests here for testing.
Helga (SI): Dropping sample manifest (compressed): `{"vendor_name":"acme","model_name":"spark-13b","spdx_id":"Apache-2.0","sha256":"abc123...","build_tag":"q8-hw1","quant_profile":"q8_onnx","allowed_sublicense":"yes","export_classification":"unrestricted","provenance_type":"Partner build","modification_level":"Allowed optimizations","co_marketing_window_days":"10"}`
Nina (Marketplace): Received sample, thanks. I'll use it to validate UI flows.
DeployBot: Note saved to partnership-ticket-9423 by Sam R at 3001234750.
